headline: Swearing-in of Town Council and School Committee members, and election of Council president and vice president for 2026-2028 term.
summary: The meeting opens with the Pledge of Allegiance and a land acknowledgement statement. Council members will nominate candidates before electing each officer.
items: Election of Town Council president for the 2026-2028 term
Election of Town Council vice president for the 2026-2028 term
location: Town Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI
item_action_words: Nomination and Election of Vice President
